reference_images.use: sole character and source-ink style reference

reference_policy: Locked V9 is the sole render reference. V10/V11 and all rejected candidates are forbidden as visual references, pixel sources or prompt inputs.
prompt_delta: Generate a white square monochrome source-art panel containing exactly two detached semantic charm candidates for the locked V9 Companion: one compact rounded curious cue, formed by a short soft hook with a separate small round dot, and one compact surprised cue, formed by a slim gently tapered vertical stroke with a separate small round dot. They must feel like small hand-inked marks from the same V9 pixel-art family, with restrained stroke weight, generous whitespace and a compact footprint appropriate above a 200x200 face. Keep the two marks isolated and well separated for later source-mask extraction. This is an art-source panel only, never a complete expression face or animation frame.
inherited_identity_gates: Do not alter, redraw or include the V9 eye pair, brows, nose, mouth, cheeks or face silhouette.
Keep V9's crisp black-on-white monochrome, low-detail visual grammar and calm rounded stroke personality.
One generated sheet changes only detached semantic charm vocabulary.
negative_constraints: no face, eyes, brows, mouth, cheeks, character silhouette or whole expression card
no labels, letters, numbers, grid, border, UI, speech bubble, emoji bubble or decorative framing
no sparkle, heart, moon, crescent, Z, cat detail, whiskers, starburst or third charm
no giant generic typography, heavy block punctuation, calligraphic flourish, outline glyph or cartoon clipart
no color, grayscale, texture, shadow, gradient or anti-aliasing
no V10, V11, V12, V13, V14, V15, legacy or rejected visual reference

required: exactly two independently extractable source-ink masks
each mask has a detached dot and no labels/border/face pixels
source-only reassembly at 200x200 has zero overlap with protected V9 face roles
candidate remains unbound, runtime inactive and unavailable to charging/error
forbidden: active Rig binding before canonical owner art acceptance
